dimensions.detail: Use of a PostFast API key, PostFast API calls, S3 signed media uploads, and connected social accounts is proportionate to the skill's purpose and disclosed in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable installer, background worker, package install, or local mutation mechanism was present. Setup is limited to obtaining a PostFast API key and setting POSTFAST_API_KEY.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language is broad and includes live posting and deletion, but it is framed around user-requested PostFast/social-media tasks and does not instruct automatic or hidden actions. The skill would be stronger with explicit confirmation guidance before publishing, deleting, or emailing connect links.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no local persistence or privilege escalation. Remote state changes such as drafts, scheduled posts, uploaded media, connect links, and scheduled-post deletion are expected for this type of integration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is social media scheduling and management, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: listing connected accounts, creating drafts or scheduled posts, uploading media, viewing analytics, generating connect links, and deleting scheduled posts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad social scheduling scope is real, but it matches the advertised PostFast workflow and is limited to user-requested social publishing and management tasks.
[SQP-2] expected: The artifact clearly documents live API actions that can schedule, publish later, or delete social content; the missing prominent safety warning is a documentation gap rather than hidden behavior.
[TM1] expected: DELETE /social-posts/:id is a destructive action, but deleting scheduled posts is part of the stated management purpose and no automatic deletion behavior was found.
llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent to operate PostFast with your workspace API key. Before any live action, verify the target account, content, media, scheduled time, approval status, and post ID; require explicit confirmation before publishing, deleting scheduled posts, or sending client connect links.
llm.summary: The skill is a coherent PostFast API guide for managing real social posts, with expected live-account side effects but no hidden install, persistence, or unrelated data access.
